what: A polyphonic synth inspired by Synth1, with 256 presets ready to play, sorted by category, and 1,024 separate user slots. Two oscillators plus sub, FM, ring mod, sync, four filter types, arp, drone and effects. Explore 3,174 community sounds or load your own banks through the browser Patch Manager.
